nom: MEDIHEAL Retinol Collagen Eye Ampoule Patch

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers generally tolerate the retinol formula without irritation or blemishes, though a couple note it can sting slightly at first or say it is not recommended for very reactive under-eye skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report strong hydration from the patches, though the gel is described as absorbing and thinning out faster on dry skin than on other skin types.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination, dehydrated skin describes the patches as comfortable and satisfying, with no complaints about texture or fit.
segments.oily: One reviewer with slightly oily skin, comparing notes with a family member who has dry skin, found the patches worked well for both.

concerns.aging: Results on wrinkles and fine lines are mixed: several reviewers say consistent use visibly softens lines around the eyes and smile lines, while about as many report no noticeable improvement even after weeks of regular use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe strong, immediate hydration from the heavily-soaked patches, though a few note the moisturizing effect fades quickly once the patch is removed.
concerns.redness: A reviewer with redness-prone cheeks experienced no irritation from the retinol formula, and others describe it as gentle enough for daily use; a couple of reviewers warn that intensive or incompatible use can bring on redness or sensitivity over time.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several with sensitive or acne-prone skin, report no new blemishes or breakouts; one reviewer cautions that skin which does not agree with retinol may react with redness or blemishes.

aspects.libelle: Patches tend to slide or slip down the face
Can pill or leave residue under makeup
Awkward spoon tool for separating patches
Case lid difficult to close securely
Container empties quickly for the price

extraits.titre: Hard to give a great review first week of use
extraits.texte: Its not the best undereye moisture patch, but it maybe slightly helps. I get puffy undereyes sometimes in the morning and started getting small undereye creases with age. Only slightly helps with both of those, and I've used better from other brands. Likely won't repurchase again.
The gel­type patch adheres wonderfully to the skin, and after using it, my skin feels noticeably firmer! Be cautious if your skin doesn't agree with retinol, as it may cause redness or blemishes!

extraits.titre: I was really impressed by how...
extraits.texte: I was really impressed by how generously soaked these patches are with the serum! They're definitely among the top gel­type eye patches I've tried. I was initially worried since I have severe redness on my cheeks, but these didn't cause any irritation at all. There's hardly any scent to it, so it's a safe choice for those sensitive to fragrances. The only downside was that, perhaps due to the abundance of serum, they tended to slip down my face a bit, which was slightly inconvenient.

My skin type is combination dehydrated and super sensitive. I've used many similar pads before, but they tend to slip off when I'm sitting. So, I've found a trick ­ I stick the toner pad under my iPad to keep it from sliding around! There's nothing particularly disappointing about this product. I'm quite satisfied with both the texture and the finish.

extraits.titre: I bought this because my skin...
extraits.texte: I bought this because my skin is thin and my nasolabial folds were becoming more noticeable! I've been applying it to my nasolabial area every other day, and it definitely feels moisturizing. While it doesn't completely eliminate the folds, it seems to prevent them from getting worse. I wish there was a bit more solution ­ sometimes the patches feel less hydrated, which is a bit disappointing. I've thought about storing it upside down, but I'm worried it might leak. Applying cream over the patch can cause some pilling, so I recommend moisturizing well before applying the patch for better results! I have super sensitive skin that easily breaks out with incompatible products, but I've never experienced any blemishes from using this. I have slightly oily skin while my mom has dry skin, and we both use it well, so it seems suitable for all skin types. I recommend it for everyone! Due to the nature of the product, it comes in a jar­type container, which I personally find inconvenient. Especially, I often think I've closed the lid properly, but it keeps opening slightly, causing me to drop it frequently. It would be great if this aspect could be improved! The patches tend to slip if you move around, so I recommend applying them while lying down for about 15 minutes before removing. I've tried sleeping with them on, but they were too dry by morning.

extraits.titre: As someone with dry skin and...
extraits.texte: As someone with dry skin and particularly dry eye area, I'm really pleased with this purchase. It's great for targeted care around the eyes. I love that the eye patches are soaked in serum, which doesn't drip or run, making it easy to use. The built­in cap doesn't close easily, though pressing it firmly does the trick. Also, it's a bit challenging to scoop out the product with the spatula.
